documents.source_caveat: Historical vehicle-specific gasoline-engine overhaul reference for Willys MB/Ford GPW; not modern all-vehicle repair. Written for trained ordnance-maintenance personnel. Obsolete practices, materials and OCR errors remain unchanged. No qualified mechanical safety review. Never transfer its dimensions or torques to a different engine.
dependencies: Separate electrical equipment, carburetor, hydraulic brake, fuel pump, chassis and operator manuals referenced by the source are not bundled.
Specialist training, tools and equipment are assumed; not comprehensive repair coverage or current specifications.
